title: GTA 6 Gameplay Reveal Pulls in Nearly 4 Million Viewers
description: Grand Theft Auto 6's first gameplay presentation shattered streaming records, pulling in nearly 4 million peak viewers across platforms.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Gameplay Reveal Shatters Streaming Records

The hype surrounding Grand Theft Auto 6 has reached unprecedented heights, with its first gameplay presentation capturing the attention of millions worldwide. According to a recent report by Eurogamer, reaction streams dedicated to the grand unveiling peaked at an astounding 3,970,738 concurrent viewers across various livestreaming platforms.

This staggering milestone makes it the biggest gaming stream of 2026 so far. The sheer volume of traffic and engagement generated by the event sent ripples across the streaming ecosystem, effectively overwhelming major platforms like Twitch and Netflix as millions tuned in simultaneously to catch the very first glimpse of Rockstar Games' highly anticipated title in action.

## A Massive Milestone for the Industry

The near-4 million viewer peak highlights the unrelenting global appetite for the next installment in the iconic franchise. As creators and fans alike broke down every second of the presentation live, the event underscored just how dominant the GTA brand remains within the modern gaming landscape.

## Editor's Take

Pulling in nearly four million live viewers for a gameplay reveal is a monumental achievement that few titles could ever dream of. GTA 6 continues to rewrite the rules of industry engagement even before its launch, proving that the excitement for Return to Vice City and beyond is at an all-time high.

Based on reporting from Eurogamer.
